guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 在 Axis Hub 创建账号
guide.description: 进入 Axis Hub，使用邮箱、Google、X 或钱包注册。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Create an Account on Axis Hub
guide.original_description: Go to the Axis Hub and sign up with email, Google, X, or a wallet.

guide.title: 了解预训练任务
guide.description: 从 Hub 选择厨房或家庭场景中的抓取、放置、堆叠等任务，操控模拟机械臂。演示按成功率、效率和动作流畅程度评分。原文称失败尝试不会上传，也无惩罚，可重新尝试。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Pick a task from the Hub, such as picking, placing, or stacking objects in a kitchen or home scene, and steer the simulated arm through it. Your demonstration is judged on success, efficiency, and motion smoothness. Failed attempts are never uploaded and carry no penalty, so retry until the run feels clean.

guide.title: 了解后训练任务
guide.description: 由已训练策略尝试任务，你在失败时接管。每次会话的接管预算为 30 秒；未完成任务得零分，策略全程无需接管并完成的任务得分最高。在失败点进行简短、精确的修正得分更好。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Here a trained policy attempts the task while you watch, and you grab control only when it fails. Sessions have a 30-second takeover budget: incomplete attempts score zero, while runs the policy finishes untouched score highest. Short, precise corrections at the failure point score best.

guide.title: 在链上签署任务提交
guide.description: 原文要求在作品集（Portfolio）中，对每个已完成任务在 Base 上签名；签名后才计入 Axis Points。签名内容、手续费及资格仍需核对官方说明。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open your Portfolio and sign each completed task on Base. Signing is what makes a submission count toward Axis Points.

guide.title: 覆盖不同任务场景与技能
guide.description: 多样性按场景和技能两个维度衡量，因此需要兼顾两者，避免重复单一组合。原文称每个账号对每项任务最多计入 5 次完成，超出次数不计分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Spread Your Tasks Across Scenarios and Skills
guide.original_description: Diversity is measured on two axes, the scenes your tasks cover and the skills they exercise, so vary both rather than repeating one combo. The Hub also caps each task at 5 completions per account, and anything past the cap is excluded from scoring.

guide.title: 检查你的挑战者计划访问权限
guide.description: 挑战者计划提供更难的任务，其得分是标准任务的两到三倍。检查你的作品集中的“寻找看不见的”徽章；亮起的徽章意味着你已列入本周的白名单新任务每周一在 16:00 SGT 掉落，先到先得
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: The Challenger Program offers harder tasks worth two to three times the points of a standard task. Check the “Seek the Unseen” badge in your Portfolio; a lit badge means you made this week’s whitelist New tasks drop every Monday at 16:00 SGT, first come, first served

guide.title: 加入联盟任务
guide.description: 联盟任务是与生态系统合作伙伴共同构建的，并根据活动条款支付安讯士积分和合作伙伴奖励。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Alliance tasks are built with ecosystem partners and pay Axis Points plus a partner reward under campaign terms.

guide.title: 邀请活跃贡献者
guide.description: 分享你在中心的邀请链接。只有直接受邀者才算数，根据他们完成和签署的任务来衡量。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Share your referral link from the Hub. Only direct invitees count, measured by the tasks they complete and sign.

guide.title: 加入 Kaito 内容创作者计划
guide.description: Kaito 上的创作者活动的 Epoch 2 持续到 10 月 18、2026。这是 TGE 之前的最后一个纪元。在 Kaito Studio 的活动页面上申请，获取你的短链接在 X 上发布有关 Axis 的帖子，每个时期最多提交 10 帖子；你的最佳 6 计数使用你的 Kaito 链接与现有用户联系，因为他们的签名轨迹会提高你的推荐倍数只有综合排行榜上排名靠前的 500 才能获得奖励，可在 TGE 左右在 Kaito 上领取。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Enter the Kaito Content Creator Program
guide.original_description: Epoch 2 of the creator campaign on Kaito runs until October 18, 2026. It is the last epoch before TGE. Apply on the campaign page in Kaito Studio to get your short link Post about Axis on X and submit up to 10 posts per epoch; your best 6 count Use your Kaito link to onboard users, since their signed trajectories raise your referral multiplier Only the top 500 on the combined leaderboard receive rewards, claimable on Kaito around TGE.

sourcedDescription: Axis Robotics has confirmed a Community Contributor Airdrop in its published tokenomics, which moves it onto the list of confirmed airdrops . The Contributor Rewards pool holds 10% of the $AXIS supply and is paid out over two seasons: Season 1 covers simulation work done before TGE, while Season 2 opens after TGE and focuses on sim-to-real tasks. Axis Points are one input for eligibility and allocation. Exact conversion terms will be published before the claim.
